rows.scope: Compile imports the message file replacing each file domain (pre-existing ids removed), generates one include per target (single or domain-mapped), and with merge=1 restores earlier ids of mapped domains. Native p1-p4. Message importer and include generator are providers; validation of malformed includeFiles not exercised.

Resolved children: the single include, or for the mapped form $piece(includeFiles,":",2) of the whole attribute, which with two or more entries is a comma-joined name matching no include; %Clean deletes only resolved children. Native p1/p2 child names, u1, u2. Messages left after uninstall are the C:D59 class and are not re-filed.
